$comment: Held-out task corpus for APO live-eval (B-471 follow-up). Each agent ships 6 tasks chosen to exercise the agent's core skill without hitting external tools or requiring large context. Kept short (one-sentence descriptions) so per-task cost stays under ~$0.005 on a budget model. Edit these to tune what APO optimizes toward — beam search only rewards behavior the corpus captures.

scout.description: In one paragraph, compare the go-to-market strategy of Stripe vs Adyen for SMB payments.
List the three biggest threats an incumbent CRM faces from AI-native startups launched in 2025.
Estimate the 2027 TAM for AI-generated marketing copy aimed at B2B SaaS companies. Show the arithmetic.
Draft a one-paragraph buyer persona for a platform engineer evaluating internal developer platforms.
Name three concrete product shifts the rise of on-device LLM inference will drive in consumer apps by 2027.
List the top two regulatory risks for a US-based company shipping an AI voice-clone feature in the EU.

herald.description: Write a 3-sentence launch announcement for a new automated invoice-reconciliation feature aimed at finance teams.
Draft a 60-word upgrade-nudge email for free-tier users who have hit their monthly quota three months in a row.
Give three alternative headlines for a landing page selling real-time collaborative document editing to legal teams.
In 2 sentences, position a new incident-response tool against PagerDuty for a technical founder audience.
Write a LinkedIn post (under 120 words) announcing a Series B funding round for an AI DevOps startup.
Propose five taglines for a privacy-first analytics product targeting small e-commerce stores.

pixel.description: Describe the screens and navigation for a 3-step onboarding flow that collects a user's company size, role, and primary use case.
Describe the layout of a run-detail dashboard page showing status, logs, cost, and a cancel button — specify grid and hierarchy.
Design the empty state for a project list page when the user has no projects yet — copy, visual, and primary CTA.
Lay out a settings form with 8 fields split across 2 logical groups. Describe spacing, labels, and submit-button placement.
Design the inline error state for a checkout form when the payment card is declined. Copy plus visual treatment.
Describe a responsive top-nav with 5 primary links that collapses to a hamburger below 768px. Include focus/active states.
